pr_title: Nodes: Only use PMREM for background when blurriness is configured.
pr_body:
Fixed #28827.

**Description**

PMREM is now only used for the background when blurriness is defined. Otherwise the cube map format is used like in `WebGLRenderer` which should fix the quality differences mentioned in #28827.

issue_context.title: WebGPURenderer: Issues with PMREM `Background`.
issue_context.body:
### Description

When working at the environment map, I've noticed two issues:

1. When an environment map is assigned to `Scene.background`, the background node is always a `PMREMNode` which is not right. When no background blurriness is applied, the cube map format should be used. Since this is not the case, you can spot quality differences in the background when comparing below examples:

- https://threejs.org/examples/webgl_loader_gltf
- https://threejs.org/examples/webgpu_loader_gltf

Here is the code that always produces a PMREM node:

https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/bde222e3cbba0bda2af71abe78fd1866e44aab54/src/renderers/common/nodes/Nodes.js#L271-L274

~~2.  Sometimes when loading a page with a textured background, the texture isn't rendered at all and is black. When refreshing the page, the issue disappears. This does not happen if the code waits until the env map has been loaded (like in `webgpu_loader_gltf`). However, the new `webgpu_materials_basic` does not so it can be used as a test case.~~

### Reproduction steps

- Open https://threejs.org/examples/webgl_loader_gltf and https://threejs.org/examples/webgpu_loader_gltf
- Compare backgrounds

> 

### Version

r167

### Device

Desktop

### Browser

Chrome

### OS

MacOS

review_comments: `CubeCamera.update()` isn't MRT compatible so I fixed `CubeRenderTarget` here.

We have renderer state definition and restoration in many places, I was thinking about having a way to automate this otherwise every new feature related will break the chain of nodes that use `beforeUpdate()` to `render()`.
